name: Single-Mode Fiber Optic Cable (24F)
shortDescription: Outdoor armoured single-mode 24-fiber cable for long-haul backbone and NLD deployments.
description: G.652D-compliant single-mode loose-tube armoured cable rated for direct burial, duct and aerial installation. Compatible with all major splicing and termination platforms used across Indian telecom rollouts.

name: Multi-Mode OM4 Fiber Cable (12F)
shortDescription: OM4 multi-mode 12-fiber riser cable for high-speed campus and data-centre backbones.
description: Indoor / indoor-outdoor OM4 cable suitable for 10G / 40G / 100G short-reach backbone runs in campus and data-centre environments. LSZH jacket and tight-buffer construction for safe in-building deployment.

name: Fiber Optic Transceiver — SFP+ 10G LR
shortDescription: 10GBASE-LR SFP+ transceiver for single-mode fiber up to 10 km.
description: Hot-pluggable SFP+ transceiver supporting 10GBASE-LR over single-mode fiber. Coded for compatibility with Cisco, Juniper, HPE, Aruba and other major switch platforms used across Indian enterprise and service-provider networks.
features: Up to 10 km on G.652D fiber

name: Fiber Optic Patch Panel — 24-Port LC
shortDescription: 1U 24-port LC duplex fiber patch panel with sliding tray and splice cassette.
description: Rack-mount 1U fiber patch panel for organised termination of single-mode or multi-mode cables in racks and ODF enclosures. Includes sliding tray, splice cassette and cable management for easy patching and maintenance.

name: Cat6A U/UTP Cable (305m)
shortDescription: 10G-ready Cat6A U/UTP LSZH cable in 305m pull box for structured cabling deployments.
description: Tier-1 Cat6A U/UTP cable certified to TIA-568.2-D, supporting 10GBASE-T to 100m. LSZH jacket for indoor backbone and horizontal runs in commercial buildings, hospitals and data centres.

name: FTTH Fiber Access Terminal (16-port)
shortDescription: Outdoor IP65 16-port fiber access terminal for last-mile FTTH drop connectivity.
description: Wall- or pole-mounted IP65 FTTH FAT for last-mile drop connections in residential and commercial neighbourhoods. Houses pre-terminated SC/APC adapters, splice tray and integrated splitter capacity.
features: Splice tray and cable management included
